ValidationRule.description: A discount product should always have a service or a range as parent product.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), RecordType.Name= 'Discount', OR((ER_Solution__r.RecordType.Name= 'Solution'), ER_Solution__r.RecordType.Name= 'Discount', ISBLANK(ER_Solution__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRER01 - Discount product can only have service or range as product object.
